name: My Hours
description:
My Hours is project-based time tracking for teams who bill their time. Track hours, projects, tasks, billable rates and budgets, then see where the time went and what it was worth. Rated 4.7/5 by users on Capterra and G2, with 1.6 billion hours logged.

Connect My Hours to Claude and ask about your time data instead of building a report. Ask how many hours the team logged last week, how much of it was billable, who is under or over their target hours, or which projects and tasks people worked on. Claude reads your timesheets, compares periods, spots gaps and summarises the answer in plain language.

You can also log time straight from the chat. Tell Claude what you worked on, how long, and on which project or task, and it writes the entry for you. Admins can log time for other people on the team.

From one person's week to the whole team's utilization, My Hours plus Claude is a faster way to ask, understand and record your time.

_published_faq.name: How do I add My Hours to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add My Hours to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.myhours.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the My Hours MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: My Hours provides these MCP tools: findProjectTasks, findProjects, findTasksForProject, findUsers, getAccountInfo, getUserTimesheets, and timeLogEntry.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to My Hours?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to My Hours in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does My Hours MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: My Hours requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
My Hours is developed by Spica International. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
